description: A dynaset over PA INNER JOIN CH (PAID, V, CHID, PID, W), inside BeginTrans and rolled back: at row 1 Edit, assign PID 2 (an existing parent), Update, Errors, read the row, Requery and read all rows; Edit, assign PID 99 (no such parent), Update, Errors, CancelUpdate; Edit, assign the parent key PAID 10 on a parent with children, Update, Errors, CancelUpdate; then read PA and CH through snapshots. Asks which side's key an edit of a join field changes, and how declared referential integrity answers. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
